findings.fix: Highlight matching query terms in search result snippets using <mark> or bold

findings.issue: Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) are hidden until hover — opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
findings.impact: On touch devices or with mouse-free navigation, message actions are not visible
findings.fix: Show message actions always on mobile/touch; keep hover-with-focus pattern for desktop

findings.issue: No shared ButtonGroup component — login form mode toggle (Sign In/Sign Up) uses manually styled buttons
findings.impact: Inconsistent button group styling; no reusable pattern for segmented controls
findings.fix: Create shared ButtonGroup component with active state styling

findings.issue: All pages use 'use client' directive — zero server components — full JS bundle downloaded on every route
findings.impact: No React Server Component benefits: no streaming SSR, larger initial JS payload, slower time-to-interactive
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections (landing page, workspace list) to server components; use 'use client' only where interactivity requires it

findings.issue: No route-level code splitting — all components eagerly imported via static imports
findings.impact: Large components (ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage) bundled into main chunk — slower initial load
findings.fix: Use next/dynamic for lazy-loading heavy components: ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: No virtual list for long transcripts — all messages rendered as flat DOM nodes
findings.impact: Channels with thousands of messages cause full DOM rendering; unbounded memory growth; long session performance degrades
findings.fix: Implement virtual scrolling with react-window or @tanstack/react-virtual for message list

findings.issue: Reaction data fetched for ALL visible messages on every messages change — N+1 query pattern
findings.impact: Each message render triggers a batch reaction fetch; with 50 visible messages per page, significant overhead
findings.fix: Cache reaction data by message ID; only re-fetch when new messages appear in viewport

findings.issue: Avatar image uses instead of Next.js — no lazy loading or responsive images
findings.impact: Avatar images block initial load; no automatic srcset generation for responsive sizes
findings.fix: Replace with Next.js component with lazy loading

findings.issue: Socket.io client imported eagerly even on pages that don't need real-time (workspace overview, settings)
findings.impact: ~50KB socket.io client JS loaded on every page regardless of whether real-time features are used
findings.fix: Dynamic import socket.io client only on pages that require real-time features

findings.issue: All messages stored in single flat array — no pagination, windowing, or pruning of old messages
findings.impact: Long chat sessions accumulate unbounded memory; page grows slower over time
findings.fix: Limit in-memory message store to last N messages (e.g., 500); implement cursor-based load on scroll

findings.issue: transpilePackages: ['@chat/ui'] increases build time
findings.impact: Every pnpm build transpiles the shared UI package — necessary but can be optimized
findings.fix: Consider building @chat/ui as pre-compiled package to reduce transpilation overhead

findings.issue: [F3] Message list has no virtualization — all messages rendered as flat DOM. No scroll anchoring. No cursor pagination.
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages freeze browser. New messages push scrolled-up readers. Cannot load history beyond initial fetch.
findings.fix: Implement @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll. Add scroll anchoring. Implement cursor-based pagination with scroll-to-top trigger.

findings.issue: [F6] No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile at 768px with no intermediate state
findings.impact: Tablet users on 768-1024px devices get cramped desktop or overly expanded mobile; no progressive collapse pattern
findings.fix: Add 1024px breakpoint: collapsed channel sidebar with slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace icons, compact message area

findings.issue: [F1] No semantic color or typography system — raw Tailwind values used throughout; theme changes require hundreds of per-component edits
findings.impact: Design system cannot be consistently themed or maintained; visual language drifts over time
findings.fix: Define complete semantic token system: --color-bg-*, --color-text-*, --color-border-*, --spacing-*, --font-size-*. Replace all raw values with tokens.

findings.issue: [F3] Message composer is a plain textarea — no rich editing, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop upload, markdown preview
findings.impact: Core composing experience lacks modern collaboration features; users cannot @mention, paste images, or preview markdown
findings.fix: Implement enhanced composer: @mention popover, emoji picker, drag-drop zone with progress, markdown preview toggle, /slash commands

findings.issue: [F5] No global keyboard shortcut help — users cannot discover available keyboard shortcuts for navigation or actions
findings.impact: Keyboard productivity features go unused; users cannot learn efficient workflows
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ shortcut help overlay listing all keyboard shortcuts: workspace nav, channel nav, search, message actions, media controls

findings.issue: [F7] All 9 pages use 'use client' directive — no React Server Components. No route-level code splitting.
findings.impact: Full JS bundle downloaded on every route; no streaming SSR; slow time-to-interactive on all pages
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections to server components; use next/dynamic for lazy-loading ChatView, ThreadPanel, SettingsPage

findings.issue: [F2] No global command palette (Ctrl+K) for searching and navigating to channels, users, settings
findings.impact: Navigation requires mouse or sidebar; no quick keyboard access to any context
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search across channels, recent conversations, users, settings pages

findings.issue: [F3] Thread panel lacks parent message context — users see replies without the original message quote or preview
findings.impact: Thread context is lost; users must navigate to parent message to understand the thread
findings.fix: Add sticky parent message card at top of thread with truncated content, timestamp, and clickable channel link

findings.issue: [F4] No optimistic updates for message sending — UI waits for API response before showing message
findings.impact: Noticeable delay between pressing Send and message appearing; chat feels sluggish
findings.fix: Implement optimistic send: temporary UUID, 'sending' indicator, replace on server confirmation, show retry on failure with inline error

findings.issue: [F6] No mobile bottom navigation bar — requires sidebar open for every context switch
findings.impact: Mobile navigation requires 3+ taps to switch channels; awkward one-handed use
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar with workspace button, channel list access, notifications bell, search icon, user menu

findings.issue: [F8] No notification sounds or subtle audio cues — @mentions and direct messages arrive silently
findings.impact: Urgent messages may be missed when user is not looking at the chat pane
findings.fix: Add configurable notification sounds for @mentions and DMs; mute setting per notification type

findings.issue: [F9] Unicode/emoji characters used as icons throughout (📱, 🔔, ↩, 😊, ✎, ✕) — no icon library
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility attributes; no theming support
findings.fix: Migrate to lucide-react icons with consistent aria-hidden and aria-label patterns; replace all Unicode icons

findings.issue: [F2] Breadcrumbs present but not clickable for workspace navigation
findings.impact: Users cannot navigate up the workspace hierarchy from breadcrumbs
findings.fix: Make breadcrumb segments clickable links; add dropdown on workspace name showing channel list

findings.issue: [F4] No 'Jump to present' button when scrolled up in message list
findings.impact: Users must manually scroll to bottom after reviewing history
findings.fix: Add floating 'Jump to present' FAB with unread count; appears when scrolled >500px from bottom

findings.issue: [F10] No Storybook for isolated component development and visual testing
findings.impact: New components must be developed in-page; no isolated testing environment
findings.fix: Install Storybook with @chat/ui package; create stories for Button, Input, Dialog, Avatar, Badge, Skeleton

findings.issue: [F10] Button component lacks danger and success semantic variants — only primary/secondary/ghost
findings.impact: Destructive actions use inconsistent styling; no semantic color-coded actions
findings.fix: Add danger (red), success (green), warning (amber) variants to Button; add loading state with spinner

findings.issue: search_messages RPC has no ts_rank relevance scoring — results not ordered by relevance
findings.impact: Search results are ordered by created_at rather than relevance; users see older/less relevant matches first
findings.fix: Update search_messages RPC to use ts_rank(tsvector, tsquery) for relevance scoring, order by rank DESC, created_at DESC as tiebreaker

findings.issue: Search API has no date range filter, author filter, channel filter, or pagination cursor
findings.impact: Users cannot narrow search by date, author, or channel; no pagination for large result sets
findings.fix: Extend search endpoint: add query params for date_from, date_to, author_id, channel_id (array), workspace_id; add cursor-based pagination

findings.issue: No file/attachment metadata indexed in search — file names and descriptions not searchable
findings.impact: File search requires separate indexing or storage-level search; users cannot find files by name
findings.fix: Add file_metadata table with searchable name/description columns; include in tsvector index or create separate search index

findings.issue: Search RPC uses SECURITY INVOKER but still has potential to leak channel visibility if auth.uid() is NULL (anon client)
findings.impact: Cross-channel search visibility relies on correct client; using anon client bypasses membership filter
findings.fix: Fix search route to use req.supabase (JWT client) instead of getSupabase() — addresses existing P0 finding

findings.issue: Search UI shows flat results with no date range or channel filter controls
findings.impact: Search UX is limited — users cannot filter results by date, channel, or author from the UI
findings.fix: Add search filter bar: date range picker, channel multi-select dropdown, author autocomplete; add result type indicators (message vs file)

findings.issue: No search performance benchmarks — no baseline for tsvector query latency under load
findings.impact: Search performance regressions go undetected as content grows
findings.fix: Create search performance test: measure p50/p95/p99 latency for common search patterns with varying result sizes

findings.issue: No deploy-time audit gating for production — deploy-production.yml runs without evaluating gate-policy.prod.json
findings.impact: P0/P1 findings can reach production with zero governance gate — the entire policy gating system is advisory
findings.fix: Add evaluate_gate.py step to deploy-production.yml before docker compose up, using gate-policy.prod.json with fail-on-violation

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows are broken on every push — call run_full.ps1 referencing 5 nonexistent scripts
findings.impact: CI noise on every push; no actual governance enforcement from these workflows
findings.fix: Fix or disable governance.yml and platform.yml; consolidate into working evaluate_gate.py invocations

findings.issue: Hotfix policy special_requirements (executive_signoff_required, rollback_plan_required, post_release_validation_required) are not enforced by any script
findings.impact: Hotfix policy is functionally identical to RC — three compensating controls are documented but never checked
findings.fix: Implement special_requirements enforcement in evaluate_gate.py and evaluate_promotion_gate.py

findings.issue: audit-pr-gate.yml uses dev policy for ALL PRs — PRs targeting main should use RC or prod policy
findings.impact: PRs to production branch evaluated against permissive dev thresholds (max_p1=5 instead of max_p1=0)
findings.fix: Make audit-pr-gate.yml policy file selection aware of target branch: dev-policy for develop, rc-policy for release/*, prod-policy for main

findings.issue: Duplicate policy file sets exist (hardening_super_bundle/policies/ and docs/audits/policies/) — risk of drift
findings.impact: Policy changes made to one set may not be reflected in the other — inconsistent gating
findings.fix: Consolidate to single source of truth (recommend hardening/policies/) with symlinks or CI sync check

findings.issue: Branch protection checks exist but only read-check and warn — no enforced required status checks on main
findings.impact: PRs can merge to main without passing audit gates, lint, or tests — no CI enforcement
findings.fix: Enforce branch protection via Terraform github_branch_protection resource or GitHub API; make audit-gate a required check

findings.issue: No approval process for policy file changes — any PR can silently relax gate thresholds
findings.impact: Developers can bypass governance by relaxing thresholds without review
findings.fix: Add CODEOWNERS for hardening/policies/* and hardening/rules/* requiring senior engineer approval

findings.issue: Hotfix gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.hotfix.json exists but no workflow references it
findings.impact: Hotfix tier is defined but unused; emergencies follow production path with no hotfix-specific controls
findings.fix: Create hotfix/* branch workflow with hotfix-policy; implement expedited deploy path with compensating controls

findings.issue: RC gate not wired to any workflow — gate-policy.rc.json exists but no workflow evaluates it
findings.impact: Release candidate tier is defined but completely unused in CI
findings.fix: Add RC evaluation to release branch PRs or a pre-deploy gate in the release workflow

findings.issue: No policy versioning or schema validation — policy files are ad-hoc JSON with no schema enforcement
findings.impact: Invalid policy entries may be silently ignored; no backward compatibility validation
findings.fix: Add JSON schema for policy files; add version field; validate policy format in CI

findings.issue: Exceptions.json is always empty — no historical exception tracking
findings.impact: Cannot audit how often policy gates were bypassed or what waivers were granted
findings.fix: Populate exceptions.json from PR audit gate overrides; add exception review workflow

findings.issue: No policy inheritance mechanism — each tier policy file is a full copy instead of extending a base
findings.impact: Policy changes must be duplicated across 4 files; risk of inconsistency
findings.fix: Implement base-policy.json with tier-specific overrides; merge at evaluation time

findings.description: No sending indicator on optimistic messages
Missing tablet breakpoint in chat layout

findings.issue: No incoming webhook endpoint exists — cannot POST to channels from external systems
findings.impact: Core webhook feature completely absent; greenfield implementation required
findings.fix: Design POST /v1/webhooks/incoming/:webhookId/:secret endpoint that authenticates via URL token, validates signature (if present), transforms payload into message, and inserts into target channel

findings.issue: No incoming_webhooks table — no webhook registration, secret generation, or channel ownership model
findings.impact: Cannot create, manage, or revoke incoming webhook URLs per channel
findings.fix: Create incoming_webhooks table: id UUID PK, channel_id FK, name TEXT, secret TEXT (hashed), created_by FK, is_active BOOLEAN, last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at

findings.issue: No incoming webhook rate limiting or payload size limits — external systems could flood channels with messages
findings.impact: Without abuse controls, a misconfigured or compromised webhook could DoS a channel
findings.fix: Add per-webhook rate limiting (max 30 req/min), max payload size (1MB), payload validation with Zod schema, optional HMAC signature verification

findings.issue: No payload formatting/templating strategy — incoming JSON payload needs transformation into rich chat message
findings.impact: Raw JSON payloads are not user-friendly; need structured message formatting (title, description, color, fields, footer)
findings.fix: Design payload formatter: support common webhook formats (Slack-compatible, GitHub, GitLab, Datadog) with fallback to raw JSON embed

findings.issue: No webhook management UI in frontend — cannot create, view, or revoke incoming webhooks from app
findings.impact: Users must use API directly to manage webhooks — poor UX
findings.fix: Add webhook management page under channel settings: create webhook, copy URL, regenerate secret, view delivery logs, revoke

findings.issue: No incoming webhook test coverage — invalid payloads, expired secrets, flood conditions, rate limiting
findings.impact: Webhook delivery reliability untested; abuse controls may not work as designed
findings.fix: Write tests: valid webhook POST creates message, invalid signature returns 401, rate limit exceeded returns 429, oversized payload returns 413

findings.issue: Message list renders ALL visible messages as DOM nodes — no virtualization, no windowing, no inverted scroll
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages cause 10000+ DOM nodes; browser freezes on large channels; OOM on long sessions
findings.fix: Integrate @tanstack/react-virtual with estimatedItemSize for variable-height messages; implement inverted scroll (load older on scroll up, anchor at bottom for new messages)

findings.issue: No cursor-based pagination for loading older messages — chat-view fetches once without pagination
findings.impact: Cannot load channel history beyond initial fetch; no infinite scroll up
findings.fix: Implement cursor-based pagination: fetch initial 50 messages, detect scroll-to-top, pass cursor for next page, insert older messages at top while maintaining scroll position

findings.issue: No scroll anchoring for new messages — new messages push existing content down, losing user scroll position
findings.impact: When user scrolls up to read history, new incoming messages shift the viewport; user loses their place
findings.fix: Implement scroll anchoring: detect if user is near bottom (within 200px), auto-scroll on new messages; if scrolled up, maintain position with offset adjustment

findings.issue: Virtual list could break keyboard navigation — screen readers need aria-setsize and aria-posinset on virtualized items
findings.impact: Keyboard users may lose focus tracking or experience non-sequential navigation in virtualized list
findings.fix: Add aria-setsize and aria-posinset to each virtualized message; ensure focus management with virtual focus tracking; test with NVDA/VoiceOver

findings.issue: Unread indicators and jump-to-present behavior not supported with current flat message rendering
findings.impact: Users cannot mark position and jump to latest messages after reviewing history
findings.fix: Add unread marker (visual separator), 'Jump to present' button (appears when scrolled up), and 'New messages' indicator

findings.issue: No virtualization performance benchmarks — no baseline for DOM nodes, memory usage, or scroll FPS
findings.impact: Performance improvement from virtualization cannot be measured or validated
findings.fix: Create performance benchmark: measure DOM node count, memory usage, scroll frame rate at 100, 1000, and 10000 messages

findings.issue: No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from desktop 3-column to mobile single-column at 768px, no intermediate state
findings.impact: Tablet users on 768-1024px devices get either cramped desktop or overly expanded mobile layout
findings.fix: Add tablet breakpoint (1024px): collapsed channel sidebar with slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace list icons, compact message area

findings.issue: Mobile sidebar overlay lacks smooth animations and swipe-to-close gesture
findings.impact: Mobile navigation feels abrupt; users cannot swipe-close sidebar, must tap small overlay area
findings.fix: Add CSS transition for sidebar slide-in/out, implement swipe-to-close gesture detection on mobile, add backdrop blur for visual depth

findings.issue: No bottom navigation tab bar on mobile — users cannot switch between channels or workspaces without sidebar
findings.impact: Mobile navigation requires opening sidebar for every context switch; inefficient UX
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar: workspace switcher, channel list access, notifications bell, search shortcut, user menu

findings.issue: Thread panel on mobile overlaps full screen with no back-navigation — users cannot see channel context while in thread
findings.impact: Mobile thread UX traps users; no split-view or side-panel pattern for smaller screens
findings.fix: Mobile thread: full-screen thread view with back arrow returning to channel, preserved scroll position on return, swipe-right to go back

findings.issue: No responsive layout tests in Playwright — mobile and tablet viewports not tested
findings.impact: Layout changes for responsive design have zero automated regression coverage
findings.fix: Add Playwright viewport tests: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1440px (desktop); verify all 3 columns visible on desktop, collapsed sidebar on tablet, single column on mobile

findings.issue: Existing k6 load tests only hit / and /healthz endpoints — no real API endpoints tested at all
findings.impact: Load tests provide no insight into actual system behavior under load — false sense of load-readiness
findings.fix: Replace k6 test scripts with meaningful scenarios: message send, workspace/channel listing, search, WebSocket connect

findings.issue: k6 is not invoked in any CI workflow — load tests exist but never run
findings.impact: No load regression detection in CI — performance degradation goes unnoticed until production
findings.fix: Add k6 smoke test (1 VU, 30s) to validate.yml; add full load test as nightly workflow

findings.issue: No WebSocket load test: concurrent socket connections, message send, and message delivery latency
findings.impact: Realtime system behavior under load completely unknown — socket fanout could become bottleneck
findings.fix: Build k6 WebSocket scenario: 50+ concurrent connections, each sending messages, measure p50/p95/p99 delivery latency

findings.issue: No search load test — concurrent search queries with varied terms
findings.impact: Full-text search performance under load unknown — could cause DB CPU spikes
findings.fix: Build k6 search scenario: concurrent search queries with varied terms, measure response time, verify result accuracy

findings.issue: No notification fanout load test — one message triggering notifications for many members
findings.impact: Notification delivery latency under load unknown — push notification queue could back up
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: one message triggers notification for 100 members, measure notification delivery latency

findings.issue: No reconnect storm load test — all sockets disconnect simultaneously
findings.impact: Reconnect behavior under stress unknown — server may not handle simultaneous reconnection
findings.fix: Build k6 scenario: 100+ concurrent sockets, disconnect all, measure reconnect time and message recovery

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics defined but not consumed by k6 thresholds — k6 checks don't reference metrics
findings.impact: Cannot set metric-based pass/fail thresholds in load tests
findings.fix: Add metric endpoint polling to k6 test thresholds (error rate < 1%, p95 latency < 2000ms)

findings.issue: No capacity assumptions or success criteria documented for any load scenario
findings.impact: Cannot determine if load test results are acceptable — no baseline for comparison
findings.fix: Document expected capacity: max concurrent users, message rate, notification throughput; set k6 thresholds accordingly

findings.issue: k6 not declared as devDependency — requires separate CLI install
findings.impact: Load testing setup friction — no standard version pinned across team
findings.fix: Add k6 as devDependency or add Docker-based k6 runner script

findings.issue: No load test report artifact published in CI
findings.impact: Load test results not visible in PRs or dashboards — no trend tracking
findings.fix: Add k6 report output as CI artifact; consider Grafana k6 integration for dashboard

findings.issue: Thread support exists (parent_id FK) but no thread metadata, participant tracking, reply counts, or unread count logic
findings.impact: Threaded conversations cannot be built on current schema without significant DB and API changes
findings.fix: Add thread_metadata table, thread_participants table, thread_last_read tracking, thread unread count infrastructure

findings.issue: Notification system has basic CRUD but no @mention parsing, @role/@everyone support, channel muting, or offline queues
findings.impact: Mention-driven communication and granular notification control completely absent
findings.fix: Implement mention parsing at message create time, mention validation, notification preference model, offline queue storage

findings.issue: RBAC has only owner/admin/member roles with no channel-level override model or custom roles
findings.impact: Granular channel permissions, hidden channels, and role-based channel access impossible
findings.fix: Design role hierarchy with channel override model; add channel_role_overrides table; update middleware chain

findings.issue: Message list renders all messages as flat DOM with no virtualization — no virtual list, no inverted scroll, no windowing
findings.impact: Channels with thousands of messages cause OOM and browser freezes
findings.fix: Integrate @tanstack/react-virtual with inverted scroll support; implement cursor-based pagination on scroll-to-top

findings.issue: Message input is a plain textarea with no rich text, markdown preview, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, or drag-drop
findings.impact: Core message input lacks modern collaboration features; no inline media or mention support
findings.fix: Implement enhanced textarea with mention autocomplete (#channels, @users), emoji picker, drag-drop file upload, markdown preview

findings.issue: No WebRTC/STUN/TURN infrastructure for audio/video — no media server, no signaling channel, no ICE configuration
findings.impact: Audio/video collaboration feature requires new infrastructure: TURN server, signaling service, room management
findings.fix: Design WebRTC architecture: consider LiveKit, Daily.co, or self-hosted mediasoup for media server

findings.issue: Full-text search exists via search_messages RPC but has no date range filter, file metadata search, or search ranking
findings.impact: Search is functional but limited — no advanced filtering or relevance ranking
findings.fix: Add tsvector ranking with relevance scoring, date range filtering, file metadata search, paginated results

findings.issue: No incoming webhook endpoints exist — only outgoing webhook delivery pipeline
findings.impact: External systems cannot post messages into channels via webhook URLs
findings.fix: Design incoming webhook registration model, payload formatting, secret generation, rate limiting

findings.issue: No optimistic UI system — all mutations wait for API response before updating UI
findings.impact: Chat feels sluggish; no zero-latency interaction pattern
findings.fix: Create optimistic state management: temporary IDs for messages, reactions, edits; rollback on failure; deduplicate on server echo

findings.issue: No background job/worker infrastructure for async processing (notification fanout, webhook delivery queuing)
findings.impact: Feature expansion will require worker processes; current architecture has no job queue or worker pattern
findings.fix: Design job queue abstraction (Bull/BullMQ with Redis), worker process pattern, job retry/dead-letter handling

findings.issue: Current theme supports only light/dark/system — no slate dark, OLED high-contrast black, or multi-theme architecture
findings.impact: Theme engine needs expansion to support multiple named themes with SSR-safe hydration
findings.fix: Expand CSS variable token system for multiple themes; implement SSR-safe theme hydration with cookie-based persistence

findings.issue: No responsive breakpoint strategy for tablet — only desktop (768px+) and mobile (full-screen overlays)
findings.impact: Tablet users get suboptimal layout; no three-column layout adaptation for medium screens
findings.fix: Design three-column layout with proper collapse/restore behavior at 1024px, 768px, and 480px breakpoints

findings.issue: No E2E or integration tests for any of the 5 core features (threads, mentions, RBAC, webhooks, search)
findings.impact: Feature expansion without test coverage will produce regressions in production
findings.fix: Write test matrix covering all 11 features with unit, integration, E2E, and performance tiers

findings.issue: Thread panel exists but has no thread participant tracking, thread-specific unread counts, or join/leave semantics
findings.impact: Thread feature lacks participant isolation and thread-specific UX patterns
findings.fix: Add thread participant model, thread unread counts, thread join/leave API, thread notification preferences

findings.issue: No feature flag system wired to application code — 5 seed flags exist but control nothing
findings.impact: Cannot use feature flags to safely roll out new features incrementally
findings.fix: Wire feature flag evaluation into feature boundaries: threads, mentions, webhooks, search improvements, new editor

findings.issue: No release gate process for feature expansion — no checklist, no sign-off, no staged rollout plan
findings.impact: Feature releases have no quality gate beyond existing CI checks
findings.fix: Implement feature release gate with: P0/P1 resolution check, migration safety, E2E coverage threshold, feature flag rollout plan

findings.issue: TypeScript types significantly out of sync with DB schema — must regenerate before any feature work
findings.impact: New feature development will produce type errors or require any-casts
findings.fix: Run supabase gen types typescript before starting feature implementation

findings.issue: No media/WebRTC support at all — no WebRTC service, no media streams, no device permission management
findings.impact: Audio/video media is a greenfield feature requiring new infrastructure, new API service, and new frontend
findings.fix: Phase 3: evaluate LiveKit for managed WebRTC; design signaling protocol; implement media grid UI

findings.issue: No shared @mention or autocomplete infrastructure — search-bar.tsx has its own search, no reusable mention picker
findings.impact: Mention autocomplete in message input requires building from scratch
findings.fix: Create shared MentionPicker component with debounced user/channel search, keyboard navigation, and position anchoring

findings.issue: No Storybook or component development environment for building new UI components
findings.impact: New frontend features (editor, media grid, theme) require testing components in isolation
findings.fix: Install Storybook with @chat/ui package; create stories for new feature components

findings.issue: No avatar URL validation — avatar URLs are stored as-is with no format or security check
findings.impact: Malformed or malicious avatar URLs could cause issues in theme/display
findings.fix: Add avatar_url validation in profile update schema

findings.issue: No emoji picker component — reactions use hardcoded emoji buttons
findings.impact: Users cannot browse/search emojis for reactions or rich text input
findings.fix: Integrate emoji-mart or emoji-picker-react for reaction and editor use

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut documentation or help menu
findings.impact: Power users cannot discover shortcuts for new features (mentions, threads, media controls)
findings.fix: Document keyboard shortcuts in app; add Ctrl+/ shortcut help overlay

findings.issue: Message input is a simple <textarea> with no rich editing capabilities — no markdown, no mentions, no emoji, no drag-drop
findings.impact: Core message input must be completely re-architected for rich editing — cannot incrementally enhance a plain textarea
findings.fix: Choose enhanced-textarea architecture (TipTap/ProseMirror for rich editing, or textarea with overlay components for simpler approach); implement markdown preview, slash commands, and keyboard shortcuts

findings.issue: No mention/channel autocomplete popover — @ and # triggers have no suggestion UI
findings.impact: Users must type exact @usernames and #channel-slugs from memory; no discoverability
findings.fix: Implement @mention popover: trigger on @keypress, debounced user search across workspace members, keyboard navigation (arrow keys + Enter), multi-word display names with avatar. Same pattern for #channel autocomplete.

findings.issue: File upload is a separate API call with no inline drag-drop or paste support in message input
findings.impact: Users must use separate upload UI; no inline image pasting or drag-drop from desktop
findings.fix: Implement drag-drop zone on message input area, paste event handler for images, upload progress indicator in compose bar, attachment preview pills before send

findings.issue: No emoji picker in message input — users cannot add emoji to messages from compose UI
findings.impact: Emoji usage requires typing :emoji_name: manually or using separate emoji picker for reactions only
findings.fix: Integrate emoji-mart or custom emoji picker: trigger on :keypress or toolbar button, frequently used/recent emoji section, search/filter

findings.issue: Rich editor risks breaking keyboard accessibility — arrow keys, Enter, and Escape in autocomplete must not interfere with normal text editing
findings.impact: Keyboard users may be unable to type @ or # characters normally, or autocomplete may trap focus
findings.fix: Ensure keyboard navigation: Escape closes autocomplete without selecting, Backspace on empty mention removes mention chip, Enter selects without submitting form

findings.issue: No tests for paste, drag-drop, emoji, or mention interaction flows
findings.impact: Rich editor UX changes will ship without regression coverage
findings.fix: Write Playwright tests: paste image creates upload, drag-drop file shows preview, @mention selects user, emoji picker inserts emoji

findings.issue: No @mention parsing at message creation time — no detection of @user, @role, @everyone, @here patterns
findings.impact: Mention-driven notifications are completely absent; users cannot @mention each other
findings.fix: Implement mention parser that runs at message create: extract @username patterns, resolve to user IDs, validate membership, create notification records

findings.issue: No offline notification queue — notifications created only for currently connected users via in-memory operations
findings.impact: Offline users miss notifications; no persistent inbox for missed @mentions or thread replies
findings.fix: Create notification_queue table: all notifications persisted on send; delivered via push/websocket on user reconnect

findings.issue: No notification_preferences table — users cannot control which notifications they receive per channel or per type
findings.impact: Every notification goes to every workspace member; no mute, no channel-level suppression
findings.fix: Create notification_preferences: user_id FK, workspace_id FK (null=global), channel_id FK (null), notification_type TEXT, enabled BOOLEAN. Set sensible defaults.

findings.issue: No @role or @everyone mention support — mention system must resolve role members and workspace members
findings.impact: Broadcast mentions (@everyone, @channel) and role-targeted mentions (@admin, @moderator) not possible

findings.issue: No Socket.io connection state recovery — clients lose all room state on disconnect; no reconnection backoff strategy configured

findings.scenario: Network partition occurs for 5 seconds. All 100 connected WebSocket clients disconnect. On reconnect, each client must re-emit channel:join for every channel they were in (potentially 10+ events each). Server receives 1000+ join events simultaneously. During the disconnect window, any messages sent are not received by disconnected clients — no offline queue exists.

findings.issue: Circuit breaker implemented via opossum but only wired to webhook delivery — NOT to Supabase client, not to Redis, not to external HTTP calls
findings.impact: Cascading failure from slow Supabase: every request tries Supabase, all fail slowly, no circuit opens to give recovery time
findings.fix: Wrap Supabase client queries in circuit breaker; add circuit breaker around Redis operations; expose breaker state in /metrics and /health
findings.scenario: Supabase primary has a failover event taking 60 seconds. Every API request (50+ per second) sends a query to Supabase and waits. Circuit breaker on Supabase would detect >50% failure rate and open after 10 requests, returning fast 503 for subsequent requests. Without circuit breaker, all 3000 requests in that minute each wait for the 30s query timeout, completely exhausting node event loop.

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory with no persistence — lost on process restart; retry delay is fixed 5s with no exponential backoff

findings.scenario: API process restarts during deploy. 50 pending audit events in the in-memory queue are lost. findings.issue: Socket.io has allowEIO3: true enabling Engine.IO v3 legacy protocol

findings.issue: Auth redirect URL uses window.location.origin without validation or allowlist

findings.issue: isWorkspaceMember helper uses getSupabase() (anon client) without user JWT context

findings.issue: User email logged in workspace list operations — PII exposure in logs

findings.impact: User with CREATE privilege can create malicious objects to hijack functions running with elevated privileges

findings.issue: No reduced-motion token — prefers-reduced-motion not checked, animations play unconditionally
findings.impact: Users with motion sensitivity get distracting animations
findings.fix: Add --motion-reduced boolean; wrap non-essential animations in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce @media query

findings.issue: No shadow/elevation token system — box-shadow values are ad-hoc across components
findings.impact: Inconsistent elevation styling; no design system for visual hierarchy
findings.fix: Define shadow scale: --shadow-sm, --shadow-md, --shadow-lg, --shadow-xl, --shadow-dialog

findings.issue: No compact/comfortable/spacious density mode — layout density is fixed
findings.impact: Users cannot adjust information density, especially in message list
findings.fix: Add density CSS variable (--density) with compact/comfortable/spacious values; adjust padding, margins, and font sizes proportionally

findings.issue: No design token documentation — tokens exist only in CSS files with no reference or usage guide
findings.impact: Developers cannot discover available tokens; inconsistent token usage across codebase
findings.fix: Create DESIGN_TOKENS.md documenting all tokens with examples; add token usage lint rule

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message list has no virtualization — all messages as flat DOM, no inverted scroll, no scroll anchoring, no cursor pagination
findings.impact: OOM on large channels; scroll position lost on new messages; cannot load older history
findings.fix: Implement virtualization with @tanstack/react-virtual, inverted scroll for chat, scroll anchoring, cursor-based pagination. This is the highest-impact UX improvement.

findings.issue: [Phase 1] No semantic color or typography system — raw Tailwind classes used throughout
findings.impact: Theme changes require hundreds of per-component edits; inconsistent visual language
findings.fix: Implement full design token system: semantic colors, typography scale, spacing scale, motion tokens. Create Text and Heading primitives.

findings.issue: [Phase 2] Workspace layout skeleton missing — 'Loading...' text shown during auth initialization
findings.impact: Poor perceived performance; no progressive layout rendering
findings.fix: Create AppShellSkeleton component matching workspace layout structure with animated pulse placeholders

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message composer is plain textarea — no rich editing, markdown preview, @mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop
findings.impact: Core composing experience lacks modern collaboration features
findings.fix: Phase 3 implementation: enhanced textarea with markdown preview toolbar, @mention popover, #channel autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop zone with upload progress

findings.issue: [Phase 4] Search lacks filters and result highlighting — no date range, channel filter, author filter, term highlighting
findings.impact: Search UX is basic; users cannot narrow results or see why content matched
findings.fix: Add search filters: date picker, channel multi-select, author; add <mark> term highlighting in excerpts; show file vs message type icon

findings.issue: [Phase 5] No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile at 768px
findings.impact: Tablet users get suboptimal layout; no progressive collapse pattern
findings.fix: Add tablet breakpoint (1024px): collapsed sidebar as slide-out drawer, always-visible workspace icons, compact message area

findings.issue: [Phase 6] Theme customization limited to light/dark/system — no Slate Dark, OLED High-Contrast, or user-definable accent colors
findings.impact: Users cannot customize the app appearance beyond basic light/dark toggle
findings.fix: Add Slate Dark and OLED High-Contrast themes; add accent color picker in settings; persist preferences

findings.issue: [Phase 2] No global keyboard command palette (Ctrl+K) for searching channels, users, settings
findings.impact: Navigation requires mouse or sidebar clicking; no quick keyboard access to any page
findings.fix: Implement Ctrl+K command palette with search across channels, users, settings, recent conversations; keyboard navigable

findings.issue: [Phase 3] Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) hidden on hover only — not keyboard accessible
findings.impact: Touch and keyboard users cannot access message actions
findings.fix: Show actions on group-focus-within; add permanent visibility on mobile/touch devices; increase touch target size

findings.issue: [Phase 4] Settings page has no section navigation or loading skeletons — full page reloads
findings.impact: Settings UX is slow; no visual feedback during section switching
findings.fix: Add settings sidebar with sections (Profile, Notifications, Preferences, Theme, Account); add Skeleton loading per section; implement client-side section switching

findings.issue: [Phase 5] No bottom navigation bar on mobile — users must open sidebar for every context switch
findings.impact: Mobile navigation is slow; requires 2+ taps to switch context
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar: workspace indicators, channel list access, notifications, search, user menu

findings.issue: [Phase 6] No font size or density preference in user settings — all users get same text size and spacing
findings.impact: Users cannot adjust readability to their preference
findings.fix: Add font size slider (small/medium/large) and density selector (compact/comfortable/spacious) in preferences

findings.issue: [Phase 7] No visual regression testing — Playwright screenshot comparison not configured
findings.impact: UX changes in any phase risk visual regressions without detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for each phase's output: design system, app shell, chat view, settings, mobile breakpoints

findings.issue: [Phase 3] No audio notification for @mentions or direct messages — new messages arrive silently
findings.impact: Users may miss urgent messages when not focused on the chat window
findings.fix: Add configurable notification sounds for @mentions and DMs; respect channel mute preferences

findings.issue: Workflows use pnpm/action-setup@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 caching patterns but no Corepack-based pnpm enablement (visible in reference pattern)
findings.impact: CI workflows may fail if pnpm version is not pinned; no deterministic pnpm version across environments
findings.fix: Add corepack enable and pnpm version pinning to all CI workflows; keep existing setup-node caching

findings.issue: No Vercel deployment workflow exists — frontend is deployed via Docker on DO droplet, not Vercel
findings.impact: Vercel workflow is not applicable; existing Docker-based deployment is correct for current architecture
findings.fix: No action needed — Docker deployment is intentional. Document as architectural decision.

findings.issue: No .github/dependabot.yml exists — reference pattern shows this file in develop snapshot
findings.impact: No automated dependency update monitoring; vulnerability patches require manual tracking
findings.fix: Create .github/dependabot.yml with weekly npm + GitHub Actions ecosystem checks

findings.issue: No Terraform stale lock cleanup logic in workflows — reference pattern shows tfvars file creation from secrets
findings.impact: Terraform apply may fail on stale lock files in multi-worker scenarios
findings.fix: Add stale lock cleanup step (terraform init -lockfile=readonly) before apply in terraform workflows

findings.issue: Husky pre-commit hook exists and works but has deprecation warnings about v10 migration
findings.impact: Pre-commit hook will fail after husky v10 update
findings.fix: Remove deprecated husky .husky.sh reference lines from pre-commit file; prepare for v10 syntax

findings.issue: No instrumentation.ts or Vercel-specific config — reference pattern shows these as differences
findings.impact: These are Vercel-specific files not applicable to Docker deployment. Confirm as intentional skip.
findings.fix: No action needed — document as intentional architectural difference from reference pattern

findings.issue: Reference pattern shows additional migrations (5302034_ticket_comment_editing.sql, 5302035_bootstrap_portal_access.sql) for a different project
findings.impact: These migrations are for the MCT Portal, not the Chat app — confirm they should NOT be adopted
findings.fix: No action needed — document as belonging to separate project. If Chat needs similar features, design new Chat-specific migrations.

findings.issue: Reference pattern uses .mjs config files (eslint.config.mjs, jest.config.mjs) — current repo uses .ts/.js
findings.impact: Cosmetic naming difference; both work. Standardizing is optional.
findings.fix: Defer: adopt .mjs for future config files but do not rename existing ones now

findings.issue: Reference pattern has docs/portal_platform_formal_handoff_bundle/ — our repo has docs/architecture/ and docs/audits/ instead
findings.impact: Different documentation structure — intentional, project-specific organization
findings.fix: No action needed — Chat app has its own documentation structure that should be preserved

findings.issue: No load-testing README exists — reference pattern shows scripts/load-testing/README.md
findings.impact: Load testing documentation gap; k6 scripts exist but undocumented
findings.fix: Add README.md to tests/k6/ explaining how to run load tests and interpret results

findings.issue: No visual regression testing tooling of any kind installed — no Percy, Chromatic, Playwright snapshots, or Applitools
findings.impact: UI regressions reach production undetected — every deploy risks visual breakage with zero automated detection
findings.fix: Install Playwright's built-in visual comparison (await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot()) — no extra dependencies needed

findings.issue: No screenshot baselines for any of the 4 critical screens: login form, workspace main view, channel view, settings page
findings.impact: Visual regression on the most-visited screens goes undetected
findings.fix: Add Playwright visual snapshot tests for login form (desktop + mobile), workspace with sidebar + channel list, and message area

findings.issue: No dark mode visual regression coverage — contrast issues in dark theme go undetected
findings.impact: Dark mode UI can degrade without detection — poor user experience for dark mode users
findings.fix: Add dark mode snapshots for all critical screens by toggling class='dark' on html element before screenshot

findings.issue: No mobile/tablet viewport snapshots — responsive layout regressions undetected
findings.impact: Mobile users may see broken layouts without automated detection
findings.fix: Add Playwright snapshot tests at 375px (mobile) and 768px (tablet) viewport widths for critical screens

findings.issue: No visual diff CI job — screenshot comparison not part of any workflow
findings.impact: Visual regression tests exist (if created) but never execute in CI
findings.fix: Add visual-diff step to E2E CI job with configurable sensitivity threshold (0.1% pixel difference)

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for empty/loading/error states across any component or page
findings.impact: Edge case UI regressions (empty state, error display, loading skeleton) go undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for: empty workspace list, empty channel list, empty message area, loading skeleton states, 404 page, error display

findings.issue: No snapshot coverage for notification dropdown, thread panel, or file upload preview
findings.impact: Secondary UI surface regressions undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for notification dropdown (populated + empty), thread panel with replies, file upload preview

findings.issue: No Storybook installation — no component development environment for visual testing
findings.impact: Component-level visual testing requires full page renders; no isolated component snapshot capability
findings.fix: Consider adding Storybook for component-level visual regression with Chromatic

findings.issue: No screenshot baseline update mechanism documented
findings.impact: Intentional UI changes require manual baseline replacement — no workflow to approve new baselines
findings.fix: Document baseline update process: CI generates diff report, reviewer approves, new baseline committed
